publication.title: New fossiliferous locality from the Anacleto Formation (Late Cretaceous, Campanian) from northern Patagonia, with the description of a new titanosaur
publication.journal: Revista del Museo Argentino de Ciencias Naturales
authors: J. García Marsá, M. Aranciaga Rolando, G. Alvarez Herrera, N. Chimento, S. Rozadilla, F. Brizzon-Egli, M. Cerroni, K. Panzeri, S. Bogan, S. Casadio, J. Sterli, S. Miquel, S. Martínez, L. Perez, D. Pol, F. Novas

locality.name: PBDB collection 239490: The new fossiliferous locality here reported is located within the Marín family Farm (39° 22’\r\n43.8” S, 67° 41’ 24.1” W), which is located close to Paso Córdoba locality, at 10 km at the southwest of General Roca city.

age.basis: PBDB assigns collection 239490 to Campanian with numeric bounds 83.6–72.2 Ma.
age.notes: Database-derived occurrence snapshot from Paleobiology Database reference 91295; not yet re-verified against the publication full text.
